entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer and planeswalker of the Gatewatch who seeks Jaya Ballard's help to become more powerful so she can kill Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A legendary pyromancer who has been secretly posing as Mother Luti at Keral Keep, and who refuses to give Chandra a secret to power.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A metal planeswalker who digs up the Sylex with his automatons, intending to detonate it on New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A tree elemental, semiconscious and hostile near the Sylex dig, who is calmed by Chandra and recovers awareness.

entities.name: The Sylex
entities.description: A giant bomb created by Urza to help defeat the Phyrexians, which Karn intends to take to New Phyrexia and detonate.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A time mage who is no longer a planeswalker, and who holds the Weatherlight still and Multani frozen with time magic before deciding to take back his spark.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker of the Gatewatch aboard the Weatherlight, planning with Liliana to kill Belzenlok.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer and planeswalker with weakened powers who is working with Gideon to kill Belzenlok.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: The captain who had the Weatherlight reconstructed and recruited its crew, and who returns Teferi's spark to him.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker of the Gatewatch who arrives aboard the Weatherlight to warn of Bolas's trap and pleads with Gideon and Chandra to leave with him.

entities.name: Tiana
entities.description: A member of the Weatherlight's crew who takes the wheel.

entities.name: Shanna
entities.description: A member of the Weatherlight's allies who is fighting the Cabal on Dominaria.

entities.name: Arvad
entities.description: A member of the Weatherlight's company who runs up when Jace arrives.

entities.name: Raff
entities.description: A member of the Weatherlight's company who is bemused by planeswalkers.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker whom Chandra wants to kill and who is preparing a trap for planeswalkers.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: A demon who is close to taking over all of Dominaria and whom the Weatherlight crew plans to kill.

entities.name: The Weatherlight
entities.description: A skyship reconstructed by Jhoira that carries the crew and planeswalkers.

entities.name: Keral Keep
entities.description: The monastery on Regatha where Jaya posed as Mother Luti and Chandra served as abbot.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: The plane where a religion grew up around Jaya Ballard.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the story takes place, threatened by Belzenlok and the Cabal.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A forest region of Dominaria that the Weatherlight sails over.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian-held plane where Karn intends to detonate the Sylex.

entities.name: The Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who destroyed a whole plane and whom Karn wants to destroy with the Sylex.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: A faction that is gaining footholds on Dominaria and that Jhoira's crew plans to defeat.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The alliance of planeswalkers that includes Chandra, Gideon and Jace.

entities.name: The Blackblade
entities.description: A soul-drinking sword that slew an elder dragon, which Gideon agrees to use against Belzenlok.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A friend of Karn, Jhoira and Teferi who sacrificed himself for Karn.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who told Jhoira of Venser's fate and has gathered planeswalkers to regroup.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker friend of Chandra who showed her how to calm someone with a visualization.

entities.name: Molimo
entities.description: Multani's rival, another tree elemental, whose seed was used in the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The creator of the Sylex.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where Bolas defeated the planeswalkers.

events.summary: Chandra confronts Jaya, who has revealed she was posing as Mother Luti, and Jaya explains she went back to Regatha to find a religion built on her and guided it.
events.quote: Two hundred years later, I went back and found they'd started a religion based on me.

events.summary: Chandra offers Jaya her goggles and asks for the secret to being a more powerful pyromancer, and Jaya flatly refuses.
events.quote: Jaya took the goggles, and her expression turned hard as stone. "Absolutely not."

events.summary: The next morning Karn tells Chandra that the automatons are digging for the Sylex, which Urza created, and that he means to detonate it on New Phyrexia.
events.quote: It was created by Urza to help defeat the Phyrexians. I intend to take it to New Phyrexia and detonate it there.

events.summary: Chandra tries again to change Jaya's mind, and Jaya says there is no secret and that Chandra does not know what she wants.
events.quote: There's no secret. To master your power, you need to know what you want, know your true self.

events.summary: Karn uncovers the Sylex beneath a broken slab in the pit.
events.quote: "He's found the Sylex." Jaya let her breath out, but she didn't look relieved.

events.summary: Animate trees swarm the crater to reach the Sylex, and Chandra and Jaya fight them off with fire.
events.quote: They were desperate to get to Karn and the Sylex.

events.summary: Multani rises as a giant of roots and branches, and Karn says he is still semiconscious.
events.quote: He's still semiconscious. He would never hurt us if he were himself.

events.summary: Teferi freezes Multani and the trees with time magic from the Weatherlight.
events.quote: "It's time magic."

events.summary: Chandra recognizes Gideon and Liliana aboard the Weatherlight as they call the group to come aboard.
events.quote: "Gideon!" She waved wildly.

events.summary: Chandra uses Nissa's visualization to calm Multani, who regains awareness and recovers.
events.quote: The angry gold light from his eyes and mouth faded to a deep blue, and she was sure she saw awareness there.

events.summary: Karn promises Multani he will take the Sylex to New Phyrexia and never harm Dominaria.
events.quote: It will never harm Dominaria, I swear it.

events.summary: Chandra apologizes to Jaya for how she treated her, and Jaya says Chandra has potential and invites her aboard.
events.quote: what you did with Multani shows me you have potential.

events.summary: Teferi greets Karn aboard the Weatherlight, and Jhoira says Ajani told her of Venser's sacrifice.
events.quote: Ajani Goldmane came to tell me. Teferi knows, too.

events.summary: Jhoira shows Teferi the Powerstone locket holding his spark and asks him to take it back, so he can help kill Bolas.
events.quote: "The Mana Rig." She held it out to him. "Will you take it back?"

events.summary: Gideon, Liliana, Jaya and Chandra discuss killing Belzenlok without the Chain Veil, and Liliana raises using the Blackblade.
events.quote: It's a sword that slew an elder dragon, and Gideon is too delicate to allow us to use it.

events.summary: Jace planeswalks onto the moving Weatherlight and warns that Bolas is preparing a trap for planeswalkers.
events.quote: Ajani wanted us to meet and regroup, but Bolas is preparing a trap for Planeswalkers.

events.summary: Jace asks Gideon and Chandra to leave with him and says Liliana cannot be trusted, but Gideon refuses and Chandra chooses to stay.
events.quote: You don't understand. You can't trust her.

events.summary: Jace leaves alone, warning Gideon not to be a fool as he was.
events.quote: "Don't be a fool, Gideon. Like I was."

events.summary: Gideon agrees to use the Blackblade if it can be found in Belzenlok's Stronghold.
events.quote: If we can find it in the Stronghold, I'll use it.

events.summary: Teferi decides to take back his spark, and Jhoira drops the pendant into his palm.
events.quote: She pulled the pendant off her neck and dropped it into Teferi's waiting palm. "Welcome back."

relations.note: posed as Mother Luti there and secretly supplied the monastery's writings
relations.quote: Where do you think the monastery kept getting those 'long-lost writings of Jaya Ballard' from?

relations.note: Urza created the Sylex, not Karn; Karn intends to use it
relations.quote: It was created by Urza to help defeat the Phyrexians.

relations.note: Jaya came to help protect the excavation from Multani
relations.quote: Yes, to help protect the excavation from Multani's attacks.

relations.note: Multani fears the Sylex because it caused him great damage
relations.quote: For good reason; it caused great damage to him.
I want to kill Bolas. It's that simple.

relations.note: old friends who share a long history
relations.quote: we're just three old friends, with a great deal of catching up to do.

relations.note: Jhoira had the Weatherlight reconstructed and recruited its crew
relations.quote: That's why I had the Weatherlight reconstructed and recruited a crew.

relations.note: Gideon trusts Liliana and plans to attack Belzenlok with her

relations.quote: This is our friend Jace, another member of the Gatewatch.

relations.note: Gideon is committed to destroying Belzenlok
Jhoira plans to defeat the Cabal after Belzenlok
relations.quote: First to destroy Belzenlok, then to defeat the Cabal
